narrative.intro: Undersea Sensor Systems has federal contract obligations of $245M in FY2026 to date. Undersea Sensor Systems received 18 awards so far, with an average award size of $13.6M. Undersea Sensor Systems obligations are down 37.9% year over year. Historical obligations show year-by-year totals of $7.7M (FY21), $12.1M (FY22), $2.7M (FY23), $1.8M (FY24), $394M (FY25), and $245M (FY26). Undersea Sensor Systems activity concentrates in a single NAICS category, with Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing accounting for $241M. Undersea Sensor Systems has smaller obligations in Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing ($2.1M), Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing ($1.4M), and Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing ($574K). All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date. This view shows where obligations sit by fiscal year and by top NAICS markets for the vendor in the current fiscal snapshot.

sections.heading: How have obligations trended year over year?
sections.body: Undersea Sensor Systems obligations are down 37.9% year over year. Undersea Sensor Systems obligations rose from $7.7M in FY21 to $12.1M in FY22, then fell to $2.7M in FY23 and $1.8M in FY24 before jumping to $394M in FY25 and settling at $245M in FY26 to date. The FY2026 total is a fiscal year to date figure and therefore partial.

sections.heading: Which industries account for most obligations?
sections.body: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing is the largest industry by obligations at $241M. Undersea Sensor Systems has smaller obligations in Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing ($2.1M), Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing ($1.4M), and Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing ($574K).

faq.a: Undersea Sensor Systems made $245M from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Undersea Sensor Systems received 18 awards for a total of $245M so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $13.6M, and obligations are down 37.9% year over year.
